2:77.text: But do they not know that Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare?

2:78.text: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except
wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.

2:79.text: to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allāh," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.

2:80.text: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for
numbered days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allāh? For Allāh will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"

2:81.text: , whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

2:82.text: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

2:83.text: when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel,
, "Do not worship except Allāh; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good
and establish prayer and give zakāh." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.
